concept: A smartphone screen shattered into jagged fragments, each crack bleeding a different color—red, orange, yellow—like radiation warning symbols spreading outward. The cracks radiate from the center in a starburst pattern. The phone's face is tilted at an unstable angle, as if falling or already broken. Dark background, high contrast, bold geometric fracture lines. Style: digital illustration with sharp edges and vibrant warning palette.
explanation: Today's news is dominated by hacking, violence, political betrayal, and escalating conflict across multiple countries. The smartphone represents the false alarm that sparked panic in Ukraine—a symbol of trust broken and information corrupted. The radiating cracks suggest how quickly misinformation spreads and destabilizes, while the warning colors evoke both radiation threats and the broader sense of systems failing and fracturing under pressure.

headlines.title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
headlines.summary: Hours later Russian authorities said its app was also hacked, with fake warnings sent inside the country.

headlines.title: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
headlines.summary: A rare humanitarian ceasefire allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

headlines.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
headlines.summary: The move by Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, was called a "despicable betrayal" by one top Democrat.

headlines.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
headlines.summary: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

headlines.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
headlines.summary: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.

headlines.title: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
headlines.summary: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.

headlines.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
headlines.summary: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book
headlines.summary: Trump had sued the media outlet after it published a letter to Epstein purportedly written and signed by the president as part of a birthday book.

headlines.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
headlines.summary: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
headlines.summary: The incumbent Republican running for re-election and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting a second Dan Sullivan to also stand in the race.

headlines.title: Peaceful protests in Germany spiral into violence and looting
headlines.summary: Thousands joined largely orderly demonstrations earlier in the day, before violence erupted in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg.

headlines.title: Watch: Heidi Klum as giant severed hand for Halloween bash
headlines.summary: The supermodel and TV host provided a gory new shock at her New York event.
